is_anopheles.evidence: A total of 446 An. gambiae mosquitoes (257 M and 189 S) were sampled from 21 sites in Africa (page 3, Materials and Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study investigates insertion polymorphisms of transposable elements (Aara8, Ozymandias, Crusoe) to study genetic differentiation between the M and S molecular forms of An. gambiae. It mentions kdr only in the introduction and in Figure 7 by citing previous literature (page 1-2, 6); no insecticide resistance target markers were genotyped.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No insecticide resistance marker genotype data were generated or reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from 21 field sites in 10 African countries: Benin, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Madagascar, Mali, Mozambique, Niger, and Tanzania (page 3, Figure 1 and Materials and Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article analyzing transposable element insertion polymorphisms in field-collected An. gambiae.

sub_country_location.evidence: Specific sampling sites and geographic coordinates are reported for all 21 locations (e.g., Ladji 6°21' N, 2°27' E; page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No collection dates or years are provided in the text for the mosquito samples.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine collections across multiple sites; no indication that these transposable element data duplicate existing marker datasets.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary files (Table S1, Table S2) cover between-population differentiation indices and primer sequences, not target resistance marker data.

assessment.summary: This study analyzes transposable element insertion polymorphisms (Aara8, Ozymandias, Crusoe) using Transposon Display to evaluate genetic differentiation between the M and S molecular forms of Anopheles gambiae across 10 African countries. No insecticide resistance target markers were genotyped.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype any target insecticide-resistance markers
Does not report extractable genotype data for resistance markers
